messages:
Front Desk: Heads up — visitor Alex from Melody Labs arriving in ~20 mins with a large crate and a ukulele case. Needs a day badge and a quiet spot to tune.
Maya L: Added alex@melodylabs.com to guest list. I'll meet them on 3F. Paper badge pls.
Front Desk: Badge printed (G-4821) and waiting at desk 2.
ReceptionBot: Guest Alex (alex@melodylabs.com) checked in at 2026-03-23 14:12. Badge ID G-4821.
Samir: Crate too big for lockers — can we put it in Storage B by the bike racks? Locker A3 has the ukulele case.
Tara: I can free up the couch and move my plant. Visitor asked for power — window hotdesks have outlets, reserving desk 4.
Jin: Delivery downstairs is labeled "Melody Labs" marked fragile. Courier photo attached in main channel.
Maya L: Yep that's theirs. Front Desk, tag FRAGILE and move crate to Storage B. Leave the locker code with them at checkout.
Front Desk: Tagged FRAGILE, moved crate to Storage B. Ukulele case in Locker A3 (sticker applied). Locker A3 code `7777` — give to visitor when they leave.
Samir: Also the couch currently has three boxes on it. If someone could shift them that'd be amazing :sweat_smile: 
Tara: On it — plant moved, couch cleared, desk 4 reserved (sticky note).
Jin: Heads up — badge printer low on yellow visitor badges. People Ops can you confirm restock?
People Ops: Yep new batch arriving tomorrow morning via courier :truck:. Will top up the printer first thing.
Maya L: Thanks team! Smoothest guest swag handoff ever :tada:
